in_sanskrit.name: Sharwanet
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of beauty
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sharwanet एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Sharwanet is a beautiful and graceful name of the Hindu goddess Saraswati. Saraswati is the goddess of knowledge, music, art, wisdom, and learning. Sharwanet is a divine name for a baby girl, symbolizing the beauty, grace, and knowledge bestowed upon her by the goddess.
